f.title: Local PV contact person in Romania is not mandatory unless NAMMDR requests one
f.statement: NAMMDR may request the appointment of a contact person for pharmacovigilance issues at national level, reporting to the EU QPPV, under Romanian Law 95/2006 art. 830(5). Currently, nomination by the MAH of a local PV contact person in Romania is not mandatory.

rows.quote: National Agency for Medicines and Medical Devices of Romania (NAMMDR) may request the appointment of a contact person for pharmacovigilance issues at national level, who will report to the qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance (EU QPPV), as per the current legislation [Romanian Law 95/2006, art 830 (5)]. Currently, the nomination by the MAH of a local contact person responsible for pharmacovigilance in Romania is not mandatory.
rows.review_note: National (Romania) NAMMDR notice on the local PV contact person (English version published by the agency); marked national. Review: records that nomination is optional unless requested. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Nominate a local PV contact person in Romania to facilitate communication
f.statement: To facilitate communication on pharmacovigilance, the MAH is recommended to nominate a local contact person for pharmacovigilance in Romania.

rows.quote: To facilitate communication in the pharmacovigilance area, the MAH is reccommended to nominate such a local contact person.
rows.review_note: National (Romania) NAMMDR notice on the local PV contact person (English version published by the agency); marked national. Review: OK (typo "reccommended" kept in quote). Double-check: OK.

f.title: Prefer a Romania-resident, medically qualified local PV contact person
f.statement: It is recommended that the local contact person resides in Romania and is medically qualified or has access to a medically qualified person.

rows.quote: It is also recommended that the contact person resides in Romania and is medically qualified or has access to a medically qualified person.
rows.review_note: National (Romania) NAMMDR notice on the local PV contact person (English version published by the agency); marked national. Review: OK. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Train the local PV contact person in pharmacovigilance
f.statement: The local contact person must be trained in pharmacovigilance by the MAH.
f.applicability: Where a local contact person is nominated

rows.quote: It is necessary for the local contact person to be trained in Pharmacovigilance by the MAH.
rows.review_note: National (Romania) NAMMDR notice on the local PV contact person (English version published by the agency); marked national. Review: "it is necessary" read as Mandatory, conditional on a nomination. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Send the local PV contact person's details to NAMMDR through an official address
f.statement: If a person is nominated, the details of the local PV contact person in Romania should be sent to NAMMDR through an official address, in written or electronic format (to the agency registry and pharmacovigilance mailboxes), to the attention of the Pharmacovigilance and Risk Management Unit.

f.title: PSMF is managed by the EU QPPV residing and operating in the EU
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance system master file is managed by the EU QPPV, who resides and operates in the European Union and is responsible for establishing and maintaining the pharmacovigilance system.
